description: This PHP source file defines the PimReportDataAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base ReportDataAPI class and provides methods for getting report data related to PIM (Personal Information Management). It includes methods for retrieving report generator services, report instances, and validation rules for API inputs. The class interacts with report configurations and handles request parameters to generate and validate reports.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class for handling PIM report data requests, extending ReportDataAPI to provide report retrieval and validation logic within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance used for report operations.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report instance based on the report name from request parameters, throws exception if the report name is invalid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Constructs and returns a collection of validation rules for the 'get all' API request, including report ID validation with callback.
